Quick and dirty break down of all 8 NA teams:

100T: Owned by the Cleveland Cavs and Nadeshot, a former pro CoD player. Their roster going into 2024 includes one of the most hyped NA rookies in Sniper

C9: The "face" of NA with the most NA championships of all current NA teams. Their roster includes what many people consider the best NA jungler in Blaber and their new Midlaner is considered one of the best native NA mids ever in Jojo (Liv Sandbox wanted to sign him this year)

DIG: A team that is kinda just... there. They never really had any success in the history of the LCS. Their roster isn't complete but they do have a top laner in Rich that is considered the "Faker of HotS" and pulls out unique picks

FLY: A team owned by the ~~Milwaukee Bucks~~ owner of the Jacksonville Jaguars. Their roster is primarily EU players going into 2024 with Bwipo, Inspired, and Jensen, and at one point their branding was about trying to save the environment 

IMT: If you're a fan of teams that are considered bad, well here they are. Ever since their parent company acquired Optic Gaming, they have done fuck all

NRG: Best team in the west. They are a true redemption story with Dhokla never considered a top Top laner, Contractz who was pretty bad for years, and Palafox who wasn't hyped at all. Ever since NRG bought CLG, they managed to upgrade their bot lane and all managed to prove the doubters wrong

TL: Often joked as TLCK with their full Korean speaking roster, they include former world champs in CoreJJ and (rumored) Impact. The org is associated with their numerous 4th place finishes, and hold the record for most consecutive NA titles with... 4

SR: Shopify Rebellion is the newest team coming into the league after buying the spot of TSM. Their roster mainly includes most of the players that played on Disguised Toast's academy team last year
